_comment: Entries are applied in order. Categories: tag_manager, analytics, ad_pixel, ad_network_aggressive, session_replay, chat_support, ab_testing, error_monitoring, fingerprinting, consent_management, abuse, marketing_automation, affiliate, push_notification, social_widget, embedded_content, maps, payments. Categories after 'abuse' are NEW and need to be handled by the scanner (unknown categories should fall through to a generic 'third-party' bucket). 'ad_categories' controls which categories count as advertising. Patterns after the original config set (ad_server, ad_exchange, ad_sync, native_ad categories) were carried over from the pre-config webspy.py so no detection was lost; ad_categories lists every category that counts as advertising. ad_like_hosts is the heuristic regex for unclassified ad-looking hosts.
